id.description: Stable POI job slug, inferred from its name when needed.

project.description: Active HitReg project folder name; infer from session context.

adventureSize.description: Size tier of the complete requested player experience, including described interiors; never silently replace it with an entrance-only scope. Physical targets come from tools/poi-review/size-tiers.mjs (footprint, measured usable area, linked features, creature groups, approaches, terrain shaping) and the install gate measures against them (job.mjs measure).

parent.description: The job id of the larger place this job is one part of — a dungeon door whose dungeon belongs to another place job. A parented job is sized as a pinpoint child (adventureSize must be pinpoint) and the size gate judges the PARENT tier over the parent plus its children (tools/poi-review/size-tiers.mjs "PARENTED JOBS").

sizeTargets.description: Written by preparation from tools/poi-review/size-tiers.mjs for adventureSize; an input value is replaced. The install gate enforces it.

read.description: What a place of this tier is, in the owner's words.

min.description: Metres: the smallest footprint diameter this tier may have.

max.description: Metres: above this the place is the next tier up (a warning, not a refusal).

footprintDiameterM.description: Measured across the place's whole edit footprint (every delivered terrain edit, clearing, path, landmark and root entity), not the landmark alone. A reservation's diameter is 2 x radius.

minUsableAreaM2.description: Connected, reachable, walkable ground (18 deg default slope limit) after walls, steep banks, the incoming spur and solid dressing are excluded; summed over outdoor and interior levels. MEASURED, never an estimate.

minLinkedFeatures.description: Distinct sub-sites joined by walked routes (a lake, a cave system, a camp, a ruin, the landmark).

requiredFeatureKinds.description: Kinds every place of this tier must include.

oneOfFeatureKinds.description: At least one feature of one of these kinds (water or a cave/interior for a large place). Empty = no constraint.

minCreatureGroups.description: Distinct creature groups (packs / camps handed to populate as clearings), not individual bodies.

minApproaches.description: Distinct ways in (roads, paths, trails, shore landings) that reach the place.

terrainShaping.description: The place must carry its own terrain shaping (operators, height patches, carves, clearings) in its delivered world ops.

hostility.description: Non-hostile: safe activities/discovery. Hostile: appropriate adversaries and retreats. Mixed: explicitly mapped safe-to-hostile transition.

description.description: The specific fantasy discovery, what investigating it reveals, its playable payoff and the physical place that delivers them. Ordinary trades support the adventure; a grim name or generic danger does not turn a work yard into a destination. Follow docs/world-standards/adventure-design.md and resolve unclear core intent before building.

hint.description: Human location description or survey instruction; exact coordinates may be resolved from current focus and map.

anchor.description: Optional known engine X/Y/Z point in metres; validate against rendered terrain.

requirements.description: Specific requested destinations, activities, enemies, NPCs, rewards or mechanics. Required behavior must work before completion.

constraints.description: User limits and protected content, e.g. safe roads, existing scale, terrain or material choices. Retain verbatim intent.

mode.description: Requested work stage, not authorization. Plan produces a surveyed design only; build owns the complete authorized POI through review. Honour current user stop/freeze instructions.
